CSS Responsive Tables

A responsive table will display a horizontal scrollbar if the screen is too
small to display the full content.

Resize the browser window to see the effect:

CSS Table Properties

Property

Description

border

Sets all the border properties in one declaration

border-collapse

Specifies whether or not table borders should be collapsed

border-spacing

Specifies the distance between the borders of adjacent cells

caption-side

Specifies the placement of a table caption

empty-cells

Specifies whether or not to display borders and background on empty cells in a table

table-layout

Sets the layout algorithm to be used for a table
